This vignette [PURPOSE]

# Context

The code processes a file called ```EcoregionExports.csv``` - a table of biomass and forest regrowth age data for different tropical forest ecoregions. These data were produced through the following steps:

- In Google Earth Engine, 
- In Google Colab,

The table structure consists of 1 row for each ecoregion, and several columns showing median biomass values within primary forests, as well as linear regression outputs from plotting biomass against forest age, from two different datasets: Global Forest Change ([Hansen et al., 2013](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/UMD_hansen_global_forest_change_2025_v1_13
)) and Tropical Moist Forests ([Vancutsem et al., 2021](https://forobs.jrc.ec.europa.eu/TMF/data)).

```{r setup}
library(here)
library(biomassrecovery)
```
